div.div: Commented on #787 Add Invidious to supported links types openable with GrayJay

Does grayjay even support any kind of redirects from anywhere? Shortened links including YouTube's own youtu.be links don't seem to work. That's just because the official youtube app hijacks them. You need to uninstall (root) or disable (adb) it for the urls to be released to other apps.

div.div: Find item in QApplication by only the objectname
I came up with this which works quite well def getWidgetByClassName(name): widgets = QApplication.instance().topLevelWidgets() (19 more lines were trimmed)
Remove one of some possible substrings from the middle of a string

For now i am gonna use file = dll.path.lower().rsplit('\\', 1)[1].replace("_win64","").replace("_win32","").replace("_x86","").replace("_x64","").replace(".DLL","").replace(".dll","") If you have a better solution feel free to share it :)
Find item in QApplication by only the objectname

i want to find any object by a objectname string name inside of the QApplication Something like QApplication.instance().findByClassName("codeEditor") which should return a list of widgets with this classname that i can iterate over if there is more then one [QPushButton (QPushButton at: 0x0000008EA3B3DD80), QWidget (QWidget at: 0x0000008EA3F33F40)] I have read this but it requires a object and i want something like * This is something i came up with for testing: def findWidget(name): name = name.lower() (12 more lines were trimmed) It doesn't even find the 'InfoFrame' which is clearly there: >>> widget("info") {}
How to “inverse match” with regex without content?

I have read https://stackoverflow.com/questions/164414/how-to-inverse-match-with-regex and i would like to know if i can apply it to a non-content regex. In particular i'm talking about: ^[A-z0-9+\/]{44}$ I tried https://regex101.com/r/NmOs7Z/1 but it does not work
